claims.text: The EMA abacavir label reports about 41% higher abacavir exposure with ethanol and says this is not considered clinically significant.
claims.quote: Ethanol: the metabolism of abacavir is altered by concomitant ethanol resulting in an increase in AUC of abacavir of about 41%. These findings are not considered clinically significant.
